title: 음량 열두
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop ballad featuring a baritone male vocal. The arrangement is centered on a fingerpicked acoustic guitar with a warm, natural tone. A subtle electric bass enters, playing sustained root notes. The tempo is 72 BPM in 4/4 time. The vocal performance is intimate and breathy, utilizing a close-mic technique with light plate reverb. The guitar pattern consists of steady eighth-note arpeggios. The production is minimalist, focusing on the clarity of the vocal and the resonance of the acoustic strings.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[fingerpicked acoustic guitar arpeggio]

[Verse 1]
[breathy baritone male vocals]
거실에 불이 켜져 있었어
아버지가 소파에 앉아 있잖아 [electric bass enters]
TV에서 야구가 나오는데 소리가 거의 안 들려

냉장고 윙 소리가 더 크지
음량이 열둘이야 겨우 열둘
혼자 보는 야구는 조용해 해설도 안 듣는 것 같아
